key_insight: OrthoPilot is a large-language-model clinical AI that continuously integrates real-time hospital data and external medical knowledge to support evidence-based musculoskeletal care across the full patient journey.
clinical_relevance: The system aims to improve longitudinal decision-making in orthopaedics, from diagnosis to rehabilitation planning, where evidence is often fragmented across visits and departments.
method: Autonomously retrieved imaging, laboratory, pathology, and order data from hospital systems.
Combined patient-specific information with authoritative external knowledge to generate stage-specific clinical decisions.
Evaluated using a specialist-validated benchmark, reader studies, prospective cases, and an 8-month randomized deployment.
evidence_signal: Across 1,870 complex cases and 8,240 inpatients in deployment, OrthoPilot improved full-chain management success, cases per bed, and patient-reported access to health information, while outperforming 81 orthopaedic physicians in the reader study.
watch_item: Results come from a specialized musculoskeletal setting, so broader deployment will need careful validation, integration, and safety monitoring in other institutions and patient populations.
